 26 October 2026 Holiday: What’s Open and What’s Closed? Check State-Wise Update
 By Jasreet Kaur Last Updated: Oct 24, 2026, 11:31 IST Is October 26, 2026, a holiday? Check state-wise school reopening dates, bank closures, Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti holidays and government office updates across India.
 26 October 2026 Holiday: What’s Open and What’s Closed? Check State-Wise Update 
 Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti is celebrated on October 26, 2026. However, schools, banks and government offices closer depends on state government notifications. Some bank branches are scheduled to remain closed in specific locations, including Chandigarh, Jammu, Shimla, Srinagar and Agartala. Here is a state-wise look at the available school and bank holiday information for October 26, 2026.
 October 26 Holiday 2026: State-Wise School Updates
 School holidays depend on state education department orders, district-level announcements and individual school calendars. The following table summarises the available updates.

 October 26 Bank Holiday 2026: State-Wise List
 Bank holidays follow the Reserve Bank of India’s location-specific calendar. On October 26, published October bank-holiday schedules list closures in the following centres.
 State or Union Territory Banking centre Reason listed 
 Tripura Agartala Lakshmi Puja 
 Chandigarh Chandigarh Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 
 Jammu and Kashmir Jammu and Srinagar Accession Day and Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 
 Himachal Pradesh Shimla Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti 
 Will Government Offices Remain Closed on October 26?
 There is no single nationwide closure rule for all government offices on October 26. Employees and visitors should check the relevant department’s official notice before assuming that an office will remain closed.
